svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Phase 2.2b — Actual Compiler Routing Architecture
svg.desc: Implemented Phase 2.2b routing for treatments A direct_llm_v1 (Frozen Direct LLM), B guarded_direct_llm_v1 (Guarded Direct LLM), C canonical_bridge (Canonicalization Bridge) and D simplex_canonical (Simplex Canonical Compiler), drawn from source (treatments.py, simplex/router.py, structural_guard.py, canonicalizer.py, llm/compiler.py, language/compiler.py). Deterministic trusted components use solid slate borders; generative untrusted components use dashed amber borders. Guard MALFORMED branches reject with no provider call. Treatment D runs a frozen Lark fast path with no provider call and escalates to the LLM canonicalizer only on Lark non-success; canonical text re-enters the same frozen grammar and a rejection is final (no retry). Capability and risk verdicts remain downstream in the Phase 2.0 mission runtime (grounder), outside the compiler. No-provider counts come from fresh-blind route_breakdown evidence (50 guard rejects for B/C/D, 16 Lark fast paths for D).

svg.text: Implemented behavior in Phase 2.2b source (documentation only) · fresh-blind n=179 counts shown on no-provider paths
deterministic contract · typed MALFORMED on violation
empty or >512-char input rejects locally before any provider call
SUCCESS is built from validated Mission IR
refusal / ERROR → REJECT · no Lark call
refusal / ERROR → REJECT · no second Lark
Mission Runtime (Phase 2.0) — downstream of the compiler, outside A/B/C/D routing
capability and risk are decided downstream by the grounder and runtime (e.g. WalkForward 25 m: compiler SUCCESS, then CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN), never by the guard or the LLM.
Downstream: src/g1swarm/mission/{runtime,grounding}.py · invariants pinned by tests/test_simplex_router.py (fast path without LLM; guard reject before Lark/LLM; at most one LLM call; no retry).

No-provider counts come from the fresh-blind route_breakdown evidence (comparison.json): 50 guard rejects for B/C/D, 16 Lark fast paths for D. Implemented-routing documentation only — not a treatment verdict.
